channel.title: Web3 Security Paper Digest
channel.description: Curated papers on Web3, blockchain, and smart contract security from ArXiv and ACL

item.title: ORACAL: A Robust and Explainable Multimodal Framework for Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection with Causal Graph Enrichment
item.description:
Summary

  • Proposes ORACAL, a multimodal/heterogeneous graph learning framework for detecting smart contract vulnerabilities using CFG, DFG, and CG.
  • Enhances critical subgraphs with security context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and LLM reasoning, and uses causal attention to reduce spurious correlations and improve robustness against adversarial attacks.
  • Provides explainable subgraph-level evidence using PGExplainer to identify vulnerability-triggering paths, improving audit transparency.
  • Reports state-of-the-art vulnerability detection performance and robustness under adversarial attacks.

Paper Type

  • Research

Additional Information

  • Authors: ['Tran Duong Minh Dai', 'Triet Huynh Minh Le', 'M. Ali Babar', 'Van-Hau Pham', 'Phan The Duy']
  • Tags: ['smart-contract-security', 'vulnerability-detection', 'graph neural networks', 'explainable-AI', 'adversarial-robustness']

item.title: Robust Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection via Contrastive Learning-Enhanced Granular-ball Training
item.description:
Summary

  • Proposes CGBC, a smart-contract vulnerability detection method that improves robustness under noisy/incorrect vulnerability labels.
  • Uses granular-ball clustering to form coarse-grained representations and correct noisy labels via intra/inter-cluster loss terms.
  • Enhances representations using unsupervised contrastive learning with semantic-consistent smart contract augmentation.
  • Employs symmetric cross-entropy loss to further mitigate label noise during training and improves detection effectiveness versus baselines.

Paper Type

  • Research

Additional Information

  • Authors: ['Zeli Wang', 'Qingxuan Yang', 'Shuyin Xia', 'Yueming Wu', 'Bo Liu', 'Longlong Lin']
  • Tags: ['Smart Contract Security', 'Vulnerability Detection', 'Machine Learning for Security', 'Noisy Labels/Robust Learning', 'Contrastive Learning']
